I counted the breaths for one full minute while the child was calm, and the respiratory rate is 50 per minute. The cough has been present for 3 days. There is no chest indrawing, and the child is not convulsing now. The child has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. Pulse oximeter is not available. The child does not have recurrent wheeze, stridor when calm, or wheezing.
